concept_boundary: This is a standing collection universe, not the registry of sources already incorporated into Atlas evidence. Inclusion means routinely inspect, not presume credibility.
proposition_specific_reliability_rule: No universal truth score is assigned. Source value depends on the proposition: first-party/state media may be strongest evidence of what an actor claimed while weak evidence that the claimed occurrence/effect happened.

cadence_semantics.event-driven: check when event/task requires plus periodic liveness review
